# [EPIC] Advanced Services: AI Service & Media Service

## Epic

AI-powered recommendations, chat, and semantic search over Filmpire's own movie catalog, plus self-hosted voice control — all backed by a local Ollama model, no third-party AI vendor. A media service for user-uploaded assets (MinIO + MongoDB) rounds out the epic. Per `docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md` §3.7-3.8.

## Business Value

Shows AI-native product features and object-storage patterns running end-to-end without a paid API dependency — a stronger technical-interview showcase than a pure TMDB proxy.

## Product Goal alignment

Serves the Product Goal's "$0 real cost, production-grade practice" bar (`docs/process/PRODUCT_GOAL.md`, ADR-004) — Ollama and self-hosted Vosk keep this epic's entire AI surface off any paid API.

## Notes

- #93 (AI service): recommendations, chat, semantic search, voice control, and live verification against the real stack (#48) are done.
- #94 (Media service): MinIO/MongoDB-backed uploads, done via #37.
- #95 (Playwright E2E): scripted user journeys done via #38. CI has not run them to a pass yet (#320).
- #115 (avatar and review-attachment uploads): done via #116 and #117.
- All 4 stories closed. Epic closed 2026-08-04.
